events.what: Markman proves the Hodge conjecture for abelian fourfolds (via abelian 2n-folds of Weil type), with follow-up work on fivefolds
Several 2025 arXiv preprints (2507.18999, 2507.09934, 2507.12173, 2506.17754) claiming proofs for K3 surfaces, complete intersections, Calabi-Yau 5-folds or general frameworks
events.credibility_reason: Landmark problem, no expert uptake or citation; one withdrawn by arXiv admin for policy violation, one withdrawn and silently resubmitted by its author; ad hoc frameworks; K3 surface case is already classically known (Lefschetz (1,1)), so claims there add nothing.

events.what: Anonymously sourced media report that OpenAI is close to solving the Hodge conjecture
events.credibility_reason: No paper, code or attributable claim; rumor only.

judgement.doubts: Agree with the record. Markman's result is a case (abelian fourfolds) of the general conjecture, digested via a dedicated seminar and Totaro's named guest post on Tao's blog. The fivefold extension is mentioned only vaguely ('per follow-up work') and is not separately sourced; it does not affect the code.
